IncidentBot: [SEV2] high tail latency and increased error rate for tenant 'Cygnus Labs' in dedicated-us-west-2 — paging oncall (alpha rota) :rotating_light:

Alex (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. seeing the alert: p95 > 2s, errors ~15% over 10m, queue depth spiking on pool=dedicated-us-west-2, tenant=cygnus-labs. tagging @Rajiv.

Rajiv: Thanks. pulling logs + scheduler counters now. Initial read: long lived requests causing head-of-line blocking in the bespoke queue. Their workload uses large generations + many short inference requests interleaved. The scheduler is currently allowing big batches (max_batch_tokens=2048) which is amplifying latency for smaller requests.

Alex (oncall): Can we apply a targeted mitigation for that tenant (don't want cluster-wide change)? Need something quick: lower max_batch_tokens and apply per-tenant queue shaper to limit burst concurrency.

Rajiv: Agreed. Proposed quick changes (per-tenant):

1) set `max_batch_tokens` -> 512 for tenant=cygnus-labs
2) set `scheduler.weight` -> 0.6 (makes scheduler favor fairness)
3) enable `tenant.queue_shaper` with `max_concurrent=6` and `burst_window_ms=500`

Snippet to apply via admin API (will run against private control plane):

```
# apply per-tenant runtime patch
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/tenants/cygnus-labs/runtime-patch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "max_batch_tokens": 512,
    "scheduler": {"weight": 0.6},
    "queue_shaper": {"enabled": true, "max_concurrent": 6, "burst_window_ms": 500}
  }'
```

Rajiv: Note tradeoffs — batching throughput will drop (cost up), but latency should stabilize. Also recommend toggling `allow_prefix_caching=false` for that tenant as their request mix keeps invalidating cache entries and replaying KV caches. If we turn off prefix caching we avoid long replay times.

Maddie: I'll own the change. prepping to run the patch. will do canary on 2 nodes, then push to whole pool. posting ETA ~5m. @Ivy please stand by for infra rollback in case of regression.

deploy-bot: starting runtime patch canary: nodes [dedicated-usw-22, dedicated-usw-23] — patch id p-9c3f

Maddie: patch applied to canary nodes. live metrics: canary p50 unchanged, p95 dropped from ~2.2s to ~680ms for cygnus-labs requests on those nodes. no new errors observed during 2m window.

Alex (oncall): Good sign. proceed to full rollout when you're ready. once full rollout completes, I'll run smoke for the alert and remove pager.

Maddie: rolling to remaining nodes in pool. taking ~90s per host, doing 3-host parallel.

deploy-bot: rollout complete — patch id p-9c3f applied to nodes [dedicated-usw-*]. verifying health checks.

Ivy (platform): Observability check: request queue length for tenant=cygnus-labs down 78%, p95 2.1s -> 610ms, error rate down to 1.8%. CPU on dedicated pool increased ~6% (expected).

Carmen (cs): I'm messaging Cygnus account. letting them know we applied a mitigation to reduce tail latency and that we expect some throughput/cost impact. asking if they made any config/traffic pattern changes.

Carmen (cs): Customer replied: "thanks — we did push a model change earlier today with longer prompt context for a subset of calls". seems correlated.

Rajiv: that explains increased KV cache churn + large batches. ok to keep `max_batch_tokens=512` for now and schedule follow-up with Cygnus to tune model prompt lengths or move heavy-long-gen traffic to their dedicated reservation window.

Alex (oncall): Handoff notes for follow-up (overnight):
- action taken: per-tenant runtime patch p-9c3f applied (max_batch_tokens=512, scheduler.weight=0.6, queue_shaper enabled).
- immediate impact: p95 dropped to ~600ms, errors -> 1.8%
- tradeoffs: throughput efficiency reduced; cost/unit may rise for tenant. CPU increase normal.
- next steps: Rajiv to validate no regression in cost-sensitive paths and run longer 3h stability test; Carmen to coordinate with customer on traffic shaping and model/context changes; Maddie/Ivy to revert if any regressions.

Rajiv: I'll run the 3h stability and collect evals + replay traces to ensure we didn't mask a deeper scheduler bug. leaving a watch for the next 6 hours.

Alex (oncall): I'm un-alerting pager. leaving thread open for updates. handing incident to Rajiv for follow-up (overnight). Rajiv — ping me if anything spikes. :handshake:

IncidentBot: Pager closed by Alex (oncall) — SEV2 mitigated, monitoring.

Rajiv: quick note — captured a sample of slow traces and attached to the runbook (link: https://internal/runs/cygnus-1727654321). will summarize root cause in morning: likely prompt/context size causing KV cache thrash combined with large `max_batch_tokens` head-of-line blocking.

Carmen (cs): update to customer: "We've applied a per-tenant shaper and reduced batch size; latency should be improved. We'll follow up on best practices for prompt sizes and scheduling heavy jobs." they acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

Maddie: marking this change in audit logs + runtime config history. patch id p-9c3f recorded.

Alex (oncall): Thanks team. closing loop for this pager.
